description.narrative: ADB and FMO are collaborating to catalyse gender-responsive transition finance for MSMEs through a study that aims to (i) assess the status of transition finance in two countries – India and Viet Nam, and (ii) using the findings of the assessment, develop a practical guide for FIs on providing transition finance to MSMEs with a gender lens. In addition, the study will reflect the trend of sustainable finance guiding market players on how transition finance will relate to green finance. It is also envisaged that the results of this study will create a pipeline of MSME and FI investment opportunities that ADB and FMO can help finance and crowd in private investment.
